author: Craven, Wesley Frank; Cate, James Lea (eds.)
title: The Army Air Forces in World War II, Volume I: Plans and Early Operations, January 1939 to August 1942
notes: The US Army Air Forces' own history, and the volume that carries chapter 6, 'Pearl Harbor and Clark Field' — the two air disasters of the first day treated as one subject, which is the right frame and not the usual one. Used in this pack for the clock times of the two waves over Oahu and for the aircraft lost in the Philippines. A US government work in the public domain. **No publisher, city or year is recorded here, and that is deliberate**: the HyperWar transcription carries no imprint, copyright line or title page, and none could be opened from this environment, so under rule 3 the fields are left empty rather than filled from a catalogue. The editors and the volume title are as printed on the transcription's own index page. Same reachability note as source:morton-1962 — the official host answers 403 to this repository, the url is the HyperWar transcription, and page numbers read through it are treated as approximate (see the pack README).
